experience.title: Full Stack Engineer
bullets: Developed trip audit service components and operational interface features using Python, Java, and React within workflows covering more than 200,000 weekly trips, implementing validation and traceable processing.

Designed the transaction-validation component using Kafka and Python for more than 75,000 daily bookings, separating validation from downstream updates so exceptions could be investigated without interrupting routine processing.

Implemented container build and integration-check steps using Docker, Kubernetes, and GitHub Actions within the team's delivery workflow, supporting repeatable releases and documented rollback procedures for AWS services.

Implemented Prometheus and Grafana dashboard views within an observability environment covering more than 50,000 telemetry metrics, connecting processing failures with operational workflows to support diagnosis of production anomalies.

Implemented the cache lookup and fallback component within workflows supporting more than one million monthly transactions, applying semantic matching to reuse suitable results while preserving application response quality.

Investigated operational interface latency using Prometheus and Grafana telemetry, contributing performance fixes that brought response times to 1.2 seconds while preserving access to trip audit and transaction-validation workflows.

Evaluated semantic matching behavior in the Python caching component against similarity thresholds above 0.85, checking fallback handling to distinguish reusable responses from requests that required fresh processing.

Developed JSP, HTML, and CSS dashboard views within reporting workflows tracking more than 120 operational KPIs, connecting Spring Boot controllers with audit data to improve visibility for business users.

Refactored Java backend classes and reusable rendering components within audit applications, contributing to more than 200 developer hours saved in bug resolution while simplifying maintenance of recurring workflows.
